explication: aws-doctor is a terminal AWS account health checker for cost comparisons, spending trends, and waste discovery, with table/JSON/CSV output and PDF reports. The principal workflow is CLI invocation, AWS configuration, analysis against AWS APIs, then rendered results or a report. Waste analysis also supports selected checks and interactive navigation. The source index and sampled excerpts establish several service dependencies; other documented capabilities are retained where their internal wiring was not sampled, so those links are marked unverified or omitted.
